milestone: Bug G verbatim from BACKLOG.md: 'For texts allow these curves' (screenshot of arc-shaped text). Text objects now support a per-object arc/curve on top of every existing typography/rotation control, symmetric across all three authoring surfaces: (a) World Builder v2 Text Experience Inspector (worldBuilderApp.js) exposes a Curve range (-180..180) writing to props.textCurve via _range/_buildFieldGroup; (b) Story-owned freeform text stickers in Studio expose a Curve slider paired with Spin via _pairRow in js/contextPanel.js's _appendStickerTextEditControl, writing st.curve via SceneEngine.updateSticker's shallow-merge; (c) World-owned text quick-edit popup exposes Curve via setContentOverride(slide, sceneObj.id, 'curve').
